$comment: Pins the single-hop reading of a stray `chain_hash` (#176 item 11, one-way door; see the draft PR). The token is otherwise del-001, validly signed by B, so the extra claim is the only defect under test. `aitp-delegation.schema.json` admits `chain_hash` without `chain`, because it describes both profiles, so the claims are schema-valid and the rejection comes from the core claim set.
description: Same token as del-001, except that the delegation claims carry a `chain_hash` and no `chain`. `chain_hash` is an RFC-AITP-0011 claim, not part of the RFC-AITP-0006 §2 claim set, and this verifier has not opted into RFC-AITP-0011. An unknown claim outside `ext` MUST be rejected (RFC-AITP-0006 §2, RFC-AITP-0001 §7). The multi-hop guard of §4 does not apply, because no `chain` is present. Receivers MUST reject with UNKNOWN_FIELD.

expected.rationale: A core verifier knows only the RFC-AITP-0006 §2 claims. `chain_hash` without `chain` is a claim outside that set and outside `ext` (RFC-AITP-0011 §1.1: non-opted-in verifiers reject RFC-AITP-0011 claims under the strict-claims rule).
